summary: FD_TC_206_Not Eligible | Train Segment Disrupted | Customer Missed Connecting Flight | APPR
title: Not Eligible | Train Segment Disrupted | Customer Missed Connecting Flight | APPR
description:
Validates that when a customer's AC-sold itinerary includes a VIA Rail train segment (YOW?YUL) connecting to a flight (YUL?LHR), and the train is delayed causing the customer to miss the connecting flight, DDS correctly returns NOT ELIGIBLE. Only flight segments are evaluated for APPR/EU/ASL compensation. Train disruptions do not qualify under any regime. Goodwill (GW) may be offered at business discretion but is not automatic.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (�lise Beauchemin), 2-segment AC-sold itinerary: Segment 1 = VIA Rail train YOW?YUL (scheduled dep 07:00, arr 09:00), Segment 2 = Flight AC 848 YUL?LHR (scheduled dep 12:30, arr 00:30+1). Train delayed 4 hours due to track maintenance (actual arr YUL 13:00). Customer missed AC 848. No rebooking available same day. Disruption on train segment only � flight AC 848 departed on time. Carrier: AC-sold (train operated by VIA Rail). 72hrs: Elapsed. Time limit: Within 366 days. No duplicate case. Not employee, not infant.
